highlights: Porodo TrackFit Apex Screenless Fitness Tracker with Electrocardiogram Monitorong is a compact fitness tracker without a screen, designed for those who want detailed health tracking quietly.
It tracks your heart health using a built-in single-lead ECG sensor for accurate electrocardiogram readings.
It monitors REM sleep, daily activity, blood oxygen levels, heart rate and rhythm, blood pressure, body temperature, and stress via HRV.
Compatible with Android (8.0+), iOS (12+), and Porodo Fit, it syncs data with Apple and Google Health apps.
Made from stainless steel, ABS, and IML glass, it weighs just 25g for comfort and durability.
The battery lasts up to 14 days, it has IP68 water resistance, and charges quickly with a Pogo-Pin charger.
TrackFit Apex keeps up with active routines while staying low-key.
